title: Google Maps business input
description: Named businesses with a required state. Results are matched, not taken from the first Maps card.

queries.title: Queries
queries.description: Objects with name, state, and optional city, county, and maxResults.

name.title: Business name
name.description: Single-query name, used when queries is empty.

city.title: City
city.description: Optional city for the single-query form.

county.title: County
county.description: Optional county for the single-query form. Do not include the word County.

state.title: State
state.description: Required two-letter state code for the single-query form.

maxResults.title: Max Maps results
maxResults.description: Listings to open per query. Default 5, maximum 20.

minConfidence.title: Minimum confidence
minConfidence.description: Score required for a match. Default 80.

lowConfidenceFloor.title: Low-confidence floor
lowConfidenceFloor.description: Scores at or above this floor and below the minimum are low_confidence. Default 60.

maxSearches.title: Max searches
maxSearches.description: How many queries to run. Default 10, maximum 50.

includeEmails.title: Visit website for emails
includeEmails.description: When true, emails are read only from the website of a match. Addresses are validated. Nothing is guessed.

searchDelayMin.title: Search delay minimum (seconds)
searchDelayMin.description: Optional override. Default range is 2.0 to 4.5.

searchDelayMax.title: Search delay maximum (seconds)
searchDelayMax.description: Optional override. Default range is 2.0 to 4.5.

detailDelayMin.title: Detail delay minimum (seconds)
detailDelayMin.description: Optional override. Default range is 1.2 to 2.8.

detailDelayMax.title: Detail delay maximum (seconds)
detailDelayMax.description: Optional override. Default range is 1.2 to 2.8.

maxSpendUsd.title: Max spend (USD)
maxSpendUsd.description: Stop when the next result, proxy, or CAPTCHA event would pass this amount. Default 5, maximum 100. Later rows are saved and are not billed.

maxProxyCostUsd.title: Max proxy spend (USD)
maxProxyCostUsd.description: Cap on proxy events alone. Default 0.50, clamped to maxSpendUsd. The first Maps search stays direct. A proxy retry happens only after a block, and only when this cap and maxSpendUsd both still have room. 0 skips the proxy retry.

allowCaptcha.title: Allow CAPTCHA solving
allowCaptcha.description: Default false. When false, a challenge after the proxy retry pushes a blocked row and exits without a solve charge. When true, a solve is attempted only if that proxy retry is still a challenge and maxSpendUsd covers the captcha event. This Actor does not ship a solver, so an unconfigured solve pushes blocked and is not billed.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy group
proxyConfiguration.description: Apify Proxy group used only after Google returns a block page. Leave Apify Proxy off so the first search stays direct. Empty groups use datacenter. A robots disallow is not retried.

proxyGroups.title: Proxy groups
proxyGroups.description: Optional group names, such as DATACENTER or RESIDENTIAL. Used after a block when proxyConfiguration has no apifyProxyGroups.
